qb.notes: Stafford dealt with right elbow/arm soreness after the Chargers game; McVay acknowledged it Mon Nov 2 but deferred to Stafford. No designation yet; beat reporters expect him to play Sunday at WAS, possibly with a reduced practice load. First official practice report Wed Nov 4.

qb.notes: Cousins' 4-TD game quieted QB-change talk; HC Klint Kubiak has said he isn't ruling out a change but wants Cousins to start 'as long as possible'. No injury. (Note: Raiders HC in 2026 is Klint Kubiak, not Pete Carroll - older Carroll articles discarded.)
